title: Disclaimer
bodyHtml:
Fitness & Health

All workout content on HomeWODRx is provided for informational and educational purposes only. It is not medical advice.

Before starting any new exercise program, especially one involving high-intensity training, Olympic weightlifting, or gymnastics movements, consult with a qualified physician or physical therapist. This is particularly important if you have any pre-existing health conditions, injuries, or have been inactive for an extended period.

Exercise carries inherent risk of injury. HomeWODRx accepts no liability for injuries, accidents, or health complications arising from the use of information on this site.

Content Accuracy

We strive to keep workout descriptions, movement standards, and coaching notes accurate and up to date. However, we make no warranty — express or implied — about the completeness, accuracy, or suitability of any content for a particular purpose.

Workout standards in competitive fitness evolve. Always verify current standards through official sources (CrossFit LLC, etc.) for competition purposes.

Product Recommendations

Product recommendations on the Gear page and in blog posts reflect our honest assessment, but we are not responsible for the quality, safety, or performance of any third-party products. Always read product instructions and use equipment safely. We don't currently earn commission on product links.

External Links

The site may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the content, privacy practices, or accuracy of any external sites.
